answers.core: This is already internally implemented inside TileSetAtlasSource as `tiles_ids` which can be returned.
answers.workaround: It is possible to use get_atlas_grid_size in a loop, but then you would have to check if the coordinates form a bigger tile or if they are standalone tiles which could be perfomance heavy.

title: Simplify getting all tile atlas coordinates in a TileSetAtlasSource
